claims: U.S. agriculture contributed roughly $1.537 trillion (5.5%) to the GDP in 2023.
37% of harvested area for major crops is used for direct human food consumption.
2024 production of sugar cane is ~2 billion metric tons.
2024 production of maize (corn) is 1.22 billion metric tons.
2024 production of rice is 820 million metric tons.
Rice is a staple food for >50% of humans.
2024 production of wheat is 798 million metric tons.
Soybeans production data from 2016 is 335.6 million metric tons.
2026 projections indicate continued record harvests for soybeans, particularly in Brazil.
Small farms (≤2 hectares) produce about one-third of the world's food.
1% of global farms are larger than 50 hectares.
Farms larger than 50 hectares encompass over 70% of the world's farmland.
